body: Adversarial review round 9 (codex): audit.mjs Stage 3 extracts known model slugs from lib/agy.mjs, but the registry moved to lib/models.mjs (agy.mjs only re-exports it), so every live model is reported as a new addition and catalog drift is undetectable. Fix in skills/modernize/scripts/audit.mjs: read lib/models.mjs (non-symlink check preserved) for the known catalog, keeping lib/agy.mjs as an additional source. Add a regression assertion in test/modernize-skill.test.mjs that the full pipeline against the matching live fixture reports the models as aligned (no additions). Sync mirrors with npm run skills:sync. Acceptance: npm test green; the new assertion fails without the fix.
title: Audit Stage 3 must read the model registry in lib/models.mjs
